title: Fault Injection Testing for Identifying Critical Circuit Nodes

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Identifying single-points-of-failure in circuits is directly safety-relevant. Nodes that cause dramatic behavioral changes when corrupted are targets for adversarial attacks and priorities for robustness hardening.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Maps to activation patching in TransformerLens with different corruption types (zero-out, noise, bit-flip analog). Requires understanding of circuit discovery and ablation. Moderate for beginners with guidance.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Take a known circuit, inject faults into each component, measure output degradation, rank by sensitivity. Well-defined protocol. Achievable in 30 hours on one or two known circuits in GPT-2.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
